purpose: Remove a post-cutover false negative caused by grep -q early-reader SIGPIPE under pipefail while preserving complete Docker Compose command execution and fail-closed service membership checks.
requiredInvariants: The Docker Compose service enumeration command must run to completion and its nonzero exit status must fail closed.
Exact service membership for both web and caddy remains mandatory.
No grep -q reader may terminate the producer early under pipefail.
Readiness remains read-only and publishes only bounded redacted evidence.
The cutover remains exact-main, owner-authorized, concurrency-guarded, canonical-DNS, absent-AAAA and pinned-SSH.
The enabled-state no-op path still revalidates persistent wiring, unique web-bound upstream, immutable revision/image identity and Caddy state before returning success.
No DNS, Caddy, Compose, container, environment, application, image, database or production mutation is authorized by this repair.
Backup, rollback, TLS, host-isolation, ten-round acceptance and GO gates remain unchanged or stricter.
acceptance: Both workflows capture complete docker compose config --services output before exact web and caddy membership checks.
A Docker Compose command failure cannot be hidden by process substitution or a downstream successful grep.
The stale config --services pipe to grep -q pattern is absent from both workflows.
Workflow Syntax Guard, autopilot guard and exact-head security/runtime checks pass.
A post-merge read-only readiness run reports TLS valid, gate enabled and ALREADY_READY_REVALIDATED without production mutation.
No guarded cutover mutation is required to prove the diagnostic repair.
